name: God's Call
source:
What if you woke up in the middle of the desert without any clue as to what you are, and much less where you are?

You find yourself lost in the world with no place to go, are the ones you meet friends... or foes?
A sense of hatred, disgust, and hostility engulfs the land they call Asteraoth.
How you tackle this situation is up to you.

In a place where choices will lead to a different destiny, will you face your fears?

[From [url=https://chrys-lair.itch.io/gods-call]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果你在沙漠中醒来，不知道自己是谁，更不知道自己在哪里，该怎么办？

你发现自己迷失在世界中无处可去，你遇到的人是朋友……还是敌人？
仇恨、厌恶和敌意席卷了这片被他们称为阿斯特劳斯的土地。
如何处理这种情况取决于你。

在一个选择将导致不同命运的地方，你会面对你的恐惧吗？

[来自[url=https://chrys-lair.itch.io/gods-call]Itch.io[/url]]
